title: Enrollment and Coverage Change Terms of the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
These terms set, for each coverage level of the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, which storage unit rentals may carry the level and the periods that apply to enrolling and to changing level. All periods are calendar days.

## Which rentals may carry each level

A level may be taken only on a storage unit rental in reserved, active or delinquent status. The level must list the rental's unit class, and the level's coverage limit must be at least the minimum protection coverage of that unit class.

| Coverage level | Unit classes whose rentals may carry the level | Unit class minimum the level satisfies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled | class minimum of 2000 or less |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus | class minimum of 3000 or less |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus, Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | class minimum of 5000 or less |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus, Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | class minimum of 7500 or less |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus, Bluegate Premier Climate Suite, Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | class minimum of 10000 or less |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus, Bluegate Premier Climate Suite, Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | class minimum of 15000 or less |

## Periods and limits on changes

| Coverage level | Free-look period (days after enrollment) | Mid-term enrollment waiting (days) | Coverage increase waiting (days) | Coverage changes per rolling 365 days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 30 | 10 | 10 | 2 |

- **Coverage decrease:** at every level a lower coverage level takes effect on the covered rental's next billing date.
- **Enrollment channels:** at every level a tenant may enroll or change coverage through the care center by phone, through the online portal, or at the facility office.

## Points of reading

- Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault rentals may carry only the $10,000 and $15,000 Plans; Bluegate Premier Climate Suite rentals the $5,000 Plan and above; Bluegate Climate Plus rentals the $3,000 Plan and above.
- The free-look period is 30 days, the mid-term enrollment waiting period 10 days and the coverage increase waiting period 10 days at every level, and at most 2 coverage changes are allowed per plan in any rolling 365-day window.
